title: Demeter and Persephone
subtitle: Why do seasons exist?
subject: mythologie
description: Hades kidnaps Persephone. His mother Demeter, goddess of the harvest, leaves the earth to starve. A myth to explain the seasons.

hero.hook: When a girl disappears underground, her mother stops the harvest. The world is discovering winter.

blocks.text: **Demeter** is the Greek goddess of harvest and fertility. Her daughter **Perséphone** embodies spring. Their story explains : why the earth dies in winter and is reborn in summer. [[The agricultural cycle in Greek religion]]

It is also a drama of mother and daughter, between the world of the living and that of the dead. From this story were born the , secret rites which promised the initiates hope in the face of death. [[Mysteries of Eleusis]]

We first call Perséphone **Korah**, “the young girl”. One day, in a meadow, she picks a daffodil. The earth opens up. **Hades**, king of the underworld, appears on his chariot. With the secret agreement of **Zeus**, father of the young girl, he takes her to the Underworld to make her his queen.

blocks.caption: The kidnapping of Persephone: spring disappears underground.

blocks.text: According to the myth, **Gaïa**, the Earth, had created this narcissus on the orders of Zeus. Its scent must have trapped Persephone.

Demeter, inconsolable, leaves Olympus. It prevents the earth from germinating. The fields remain barren. A **famine** threatens humans, and therefore the sacrifices offered to the gods. Zeus must react.

Zeus sends **Hermes**, messenger of the gods, to demand the return of Persephone. Hades pretends to obey. Before she leaves, he gives her some **pomegranate seeds**. Whoever eats in the realm of the dead belongs to him. The trap is set.

A compromise is necessary. Persephone will spend part of the year with Hades, the rest with her mother. When she goes back up, Demeter makes nature green again: it's spring and summer. When she comes back down, the harvest goddess withdraws her grace: it is autumn and winter.

sections.title: In Eleusis, hope after the night

blocks.text: During her wanderings, Demeter stops at **Eleusis**, near Athens, disguised as an old woman. Welcomed by the royal family, she ends up revealing her divine nature and orders the construction of a temple. The  are born. [[Mysteries of Eleusis]]

The initiates walk nine days, fast, drink **kykeon**, a drink of barley and mint. In the , a huge initiation room, the light shines after the darkness. Sacred objects are revealed there, in the greatest secrecy. [[Telesterion]]
Some modern researchers believe that kykeon contained ergot, a hallucinogenic mushroom. This would explain the visions reported by initiates.

The rite imitates the journey of the goddess. Going through the death of nature with Demeter, then being reborn with Persephone: the participants believed they would gain a better fate in the afterlife.

sections.title: The grain that dies to be reborn

blocks.text: For the Greeks, the grain of wheat buried in the ground suffered the same fate as Persephone. It disappears underground to return as a stem. The myth links agriculture, death and rebirth.

He also talks about ancient marriage, often experienced as a painful departure: the young girl leaves her mother to join another home. Between Hades and Demeter, the final agreement holds the opposites together: shadow and light, death and life.
The stay of **Persephone** in the Underworld punctuates the seasons: her absence causes the mourning of **Démeter** (autumn-winter), her return causes the plants to be reborn (spring-summer).
